Fresh recovery after the default Playwright output cleanup removed earlier ignored
records. Both unchanged mock/supplied-art tests pass, with no skipped/flaky/retried
cases. This is a new capture, not restoration of deleted bytes.

game parity follows. The resulting-master full CI remains a separate gate owned
by the main closeout run.
